sentences.text:
A counter affidavit of the respondent nos. 2 to 5 is on record and paragraph nos. 10 and 11 read as follows:-
"10.

That in the meantime on 17.07.2017 it was observed that for process of the acquisition of land of Mauza Samastipur, Thana No. 198, P.S.-Samastipurarea area 0.0647 Acre CO Samastipur had sent proposal but the same process was not completed and in the mean time The Right to Fair Compensation and Transpiration in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013 has been enforced form 01.01.2014 and it was found that area of Land for Acquisition is much less and in progress of Land Acquisition would take more time hence the requisition be sent back to Circle Officer, Samsatipur for acquisition under the Lease process vide letter No. 863/L.A. dated 20.07.2017.
11.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transpiration in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: That from the fact stated in above paras, it transpired that acquisition process of land acquisition was not completed and hence question of preparation of award and payment of Compensation does not arise at all."

4. In that view of the matter, instead of keeping the case pending, it would be appropriate that the petitioner appear Patna High Court CWJC No.9681 of 2020(10) dt.11-03-2024 before the respondent no. 4, the District Land Acquisition Officer, Samastipur and/or the competent authority within four weeks from today who shall take immediate steps and the matter be taken to its logical conclusion in the light of the statement made by respondent themselves in paragraph nos. 10 and 11,
as incorporated above.
5. The entire exercise be completed as early as possible and not beyond six months from the filing of the representation.
6. C.W.J.C. No. 9681 of 2020 stands disposed of.

(Rajiv Roy, J) Neha/-
